title: Original Person transfer owned value operand snapshot
description: Proposed serialization of the typed31b producer contribution. Root owns aggregate serialization/adoption. Complete value operand alone does not admit a paired PC or establish natural transfer identity.
x-relational-contract: Sequences and signed decimal elements must fit their declared uint64/int64 ranges; raw Q64 hexadecimal bits must be exactly the bit representation of the same-position signed source interpretation.
payload_copy_complete means actual own count is nonnegative and both ordered arrays have exactly that count. Zero is an owned empty array, while partial and negative count keep payload null.

descriptor_copy_complete concerns independently copied data/capacity/count fields. Payload can be complete while capacity is unavailable. declared_operand_copy_complete is exactly descriptor && payload.

Budget refusal retains the actual count and available descriptor fields; both payload arrays are null and reason is values_payload_budget_exceeded. It never truncates count or substitutes native capacity.
Scopes are caller-owned actual original-wrapper occurrence/current event identities; this component issues no clock and does not infer lineage or event completion.

Only an aggregate same-snapshot proof with independently complete ordered keys and values, independent nonnegative counts that correlate, and exact process/Model/context/PC/thread/clock/phase joins may supply the paired numeric consumer. A component completeness flag alone cannot admit PC.
